A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the choice of the initial PD technique is a critical factor to be considered in the management of patients with low RKF.
the use of APD is associated to a higher risk of losing RKF than CAPD, especially in those patients with lower baseline levels.
the use of automated PD in patients with lower levels of residual kidney function should be discouraged.
The main takeaway from our work is that
APD is not the preferred technique for patients with lower RKF at PD start.
the use of APD in patients with lower RKF levels should be carefully considered.
the choice of starting a PD patient on CAPD or APD should be made after considering the patient's residual renal function.
